en.text: LORD, my God, I take refuge in you. me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华—我的 神啊，我投靠你！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華－我的上帝啊，我投靠你！

en.text: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.

zhSimplified.text: 恐怕他们像狮子撕裂我，

zhTraditional.text: 恐怕他們像獅子撕裂我，

en.text: LORD, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华—我的 神啊，我若行了这事，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華－我的上帝啊，我若行了這事，

en.text: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary),

zhSimplified.text: 我若以恶报那与我交好的人—

zhTraditional.text: 我若以惡報那與我交好的人－

en.text: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust.

zhSimplified.text: 就任凭仇敌追赶我，直到追上，

zhTraditional.text: 就任憑仇敵追趕我，直到追上，

en.text: Arise, LORD, in your anger. up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. for me. You have commanded judgment.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你在怒中起来，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你在怒中起來，

en.text: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.
The LORD administers judgment to the peoples. me, LORD, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华向众民施行审判；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華向眾民施行審判；

en.text: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.
My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.
God is a righteous judge, a God who has indignation every day.

zhSimplified.text: 神是公义的审判者， 发怒的 神。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝是公義的審判者， 發怒的上帝。

en.text: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.

zhSimplified.text: 若有人不回头，他的刀必磨快，

zhTraditional.text: 若有人不回頭，他的刀必磨快，

en.text: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.

zhSimplified.text: 他也预备了杀人的器械； 。

zhTraditional.text: 他也預備了殺人的器械； 。

en.text: Behold, he travails with iniquity. he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.

footnotes.text: 7:14 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה*”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

zhSimplified.text: 试看恶人因奸恶而劬劳，

zhTraditional.text: 試看惡人因奸惡而劬勞，

en.text: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.
The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.

zhSimplified.text: 他的毒害必临到他自己的头上；

zhTraditional.text: 他的毒害必臨到他自己的頭上；

en.text: I will give thanks to the LORD according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.

zhSimplified.text: 我要照着耶和华的公义称谢他，

zhTraditional.text: 我要照着耶和華的公義稱謝他，
